title: Hatsune Miku — Voices In Unison〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Ichika's song really is nice...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They've only played it a few times, but I know all of it by heart already for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, what was that song...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I've never heard it before.
But it sounds very nice for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, hang on... Is it a new Leo/need song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Impressive.
You knew after just listening to a small part of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was just playing a song that Ichika wrote.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She's writing songs now?! Not just lyrics?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's great news! When did this all happen?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Miku, can you play it again?
You don't have to play it all. Just what you know!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to hear it again as well...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sure, I can do that.
I was actually practicing it anyway.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's nice...
Such a warm and gentle song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, from start to finish, it felt like a song that was written by Ichika.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. It's so easy to listen to and understand because her music and lyrics are so straightforward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it's like Ichika filled it with all of her best qualities. Also...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This one's sort of special.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Special...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here's a copy of the original that she gave me. I'd like you all to listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, this is...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku's voice...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika said that she wrote this because she wanted to sing with the me over there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think I sort of understand why this song sounds so nice and seems to really hit home now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Her appreciation for Miku plays a significant role. That may be why we're feeling a personal connection to it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And the girls plan on playing this song as Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that explains why it uses the same instruments as them...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll be quite something when we hear them perform this live.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm also very excited about that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hang on. Were you practicing it just now with the hopes that you'd get to play it with them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, there's that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I also wanted to get more of a sense of what Ichika put into writing this song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I know what you mean...
This song's full of riffs and phrases that make you want to play it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm getting my guitar...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, me too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, wait! Me three!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, why don't we go ask Luka and Rin? I'm sure they'll want to play this song as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay! Then, I'll go find them!
You wait here, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was only planning on playing it a little, but we all have a habit of practicing songs until we learn them completely.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder if we'll be ready to perform by the time the girls get here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing the look on Ichika's face when we do.
